marketType.name: Moneyline - FT incl OT
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home) or 2 (away) to win the match. Any overtime or extra sets played count towards the result.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - FT incl OT
marketType.explainer: Pick how many points will be scored during the stated period. Over is more than that amount, Under is less.

marketType.name: 1X2 - FT
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team), X (draw), or 2 (away team). Result is based on regular playing time only - Overtime does not count.

marketType.name: Asian Handicap - FT incl OT
marketType.explainer: The handicap you pick is added to or taken off that team's score before the bet is settled. Pick 1 (home team) or 2 (away team) to be ahead on the adjusted score. Any overtime played counts towards the result.

marketType.name: Match Winner and Totals - FT incl OT
marketType.displayName: Match Winner and Total Score | Full Time (incl. OT)
marketType.explainer: Pick the match winner and whether total points are over or under the number shown. Both parts must be right for the bet to win. Overtime counts.

marketType.name: Odd / Even - FT incl OT
marketType.explainer: Pick whether the total points scored during the stated period will be Odd or Even. 0 is considered Even.

marketType.name: HT / FT
marketType.explainer: Pick the result at half time and at the end of the match. For example, 1/X means the home team leads at half time and the match ends level. Based on Normal time only.

marketType.name: Will the Match be Tied after Regular Time
marketType.displayName: Will the Match be Tied after Regular Time? (Excluding Overtime)
marketType.explainer: Will the match be level at the end of normal time and go to overtime? Pick Yes or No.

marketType.name: Total Score Over/Under - 1H

marketType.name: 1X2 - 1H

marketType.name: Odd / Even - 1H

marketType.name: Draw No Bet - 1H
marketType.explainer: Pick 1 (home team) or 2 (away team) to win the first half. If the half ends level, you get your stake back. Only the first half score counts.
